## Download

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| **VocabQuest-Setup-x.y.z.exe** | Installer. Adds Vocab Quest to the Start menu and desktop. No admin rights needed. **Recommended.** |
| **VocabQuest-Portable-x.y.z.exe** | Runs without installing, for example from a USB stick. |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | Checksums so you can verify the download. |

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Free and open source under the MIT License.

### First launch

The app isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"**. Click **More info → Run anyway**. Vocab Quest works fully offline, never connects to the internet, and stores your progress only on your computer.

### Pronunciation

Words are spoken with the voices built into Windows. To add or change voices: **Settings → Time & language → Speech → Add voices**.
